comment: The CUDA pack is the three packages whose CUDA build differs from the bundled CPU build,
shipped as byte-range parts of one zip. scripts/bundle-python-cuda.ps1 -Package produces
the manifest these measured values come from.
The v1.0.0 draft parts were rebuilt on 2026-10-19 because the GitHub repository
retained the old tags but none of their release assets. The former rc.10 URLs returned 404.
The CUDA download workflow uploaded these parts, downloaded every part and the manifest,
checked each size and SHA-256, and checked the concatenated archive SHA-256 before emitting
its verification report. GitHub asset digests were then compared with that report.
verified records that byte readback; it does not assert a new GPU inference measurement.
The torch version must match python/requirements-bundle.txt because this overlay shadows
the bundled torch. Rebuilds need their own measured digests; do not replace published parts
with another build while retaining these pins. docs/UNPROVEN.md records this rebuild.
